rationale.conceptual: The paper introduces a custom dual-vector embedding scheme with a specific energy model and a heuristic classification criterion. Implementing it requires understanding the physics-motivated embedding, translating equations (1-4) into code, and constructing the mismatch criterion with cutoff optimization. This is a non-trivial, multi-component method that demands genuine comprehension of the paper's approach, not just applying an off-the-shelf model.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves three main stages: downloading and filtering Materials Project data, training the embedding (gradient-based optimization), and building the classification criterion via cutoff scanning. While each stage is manageable, the need to interface with an external database (Materials Project) and correctly implement the custom model adds orchestration complexity. This is a multi-step pipeline with dependencies, placing it at a medium execution difficulty.
